entities.summary: Alan Peter Roberts, known professionally as Jim Noir, is an English musician and producer from Davyhulme, Greater Manchester. He has released five albums to date: 2005's Tower of Love, 2008's self-titled LP Jim Noir, 2012's Jimmy's Show, 2014's Finnish Line, and 2019's A.M. Jazz, as well as a number of EPs.
